title: Bug2Scenario: Root-Cause-Preserving Test Scenario Amplification for Autonomous Driving Software
title_zh: Bug2Scenario：面向自动驾驶软件的根因保持型测试场景扩增

paragraphs.en: Bug2Scenario从自动驾驶模糊测试故障中提取根因并生成语义变体，构建可靠回归场景。 Simulation-based fuzzing exposes autonomous driving system (ADS) failures by repeatedly mutating and executing scenarios, but converting one failure into reusable regression scenarios remains difficult. Such variants test whether the mechanism persists after software changes, for example by varying weather or actor placement while retaining a collision's actor-route conflict. We present Bug2Scenario, a root-cause-guided post-fuzzing framework. From scenario data, traces, and oracle evidence, it extracts a root-cause pattern. An LLM proposes semantic variations over actors, missions, routes, and weather. Deterministic rules construct DriveFuzz-compatible scenarios. Execution evidence and manual review assess preservation. Separating these responsibilities prevents fluency, syntax, or recurring labels from masquerading as causal evidence. Under matched seeds, six LLM backbones, candidate budget, and execution pipeline, Bug2Scenario improves strict preservation by 6.7 percentage points (p=0.104; not significant) and boundary-inclusive preservation by 10.6 points (p=0.011). Feedback helps some initially unsuccessful seeds yield a strictly preserved candidate. Seed-level stopping then avoids further API calls and simulator runs. Remaining failures reflect actor-placement constraints, simulator instability, and incomplete or conflicting causal evidence. Bug2Scenario thus produces reliable ADS regression assets. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce.
paragraphs.zh: Bug2Scenario从自动驾驶模糊测试故障中提取根因并生成语义变体，构建可靠回归场景。基于仿真的模糊测试通过反复变异并执行场景来暴露自动驾驶系统（ADS）的故障，但将单一故障转化为可复用的回归场景仍然困难。 这类变体用于检验该机制在软件变更后是否仍然存在，例如改变天气或参与者位置，同时保留碰撞中参与者与路线的冲突。 我们提出Bug2Scenario，一个根因引导的模糊测试后处理框架。 它从场景数据、轨迹和判定证据中提取根因模式。 大语言模型（LLM）在参与者、任务、路线和天气方面提出语义变体。 确定性规则构建与DriveFuzz兼容的场景。 执行证据与人工审查评估保真度。 将这些职责分离，可防止流畅性、语法或重复出现的标签被误当作因果证据。 在匹配种子、六种LLM骨干、候选预算和执行流水线相同的条件下，Bug2Scenario将严格保真度提升了6.7个百分点（p=0.104；不显著），并将含边界保真度提升了10.6个百分点（p=0.011）。 反馈机制帮助部分起初不成功的种子产出严格保真的候选场景。 种子级停止策略随后避免了更多的API调用和模拟器运行。 剩余的失败反映了参与者放置约束、模拟器不稳定性以及不完整或相互冲突的因果证据。 因此，Bug2Scenario能够产出可靠的ADS回归资产。 我们的实现可在https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce获取。
